parametrized_description: A daycare center has children they must pick up and can use two types of vehicles: a bus with a capacity of BusCapacity children or a personal car with a capacity of CarCapacity children. The daycare has to pick up at least MinChildren children. Additionally, due to limitations of pollution, there must be more buses than personal cars. But some children require extra attention. Therefore, there must be at least MinCars personal cars. How many of each form of transportation should the daycare center schedule for to minimize the total number of vehicles?

NumCars.description: Number of personal cars to schedule

constraints.description: Number of personal cars is non-negative
The total capacity of buses and cars must accommodate at least MinChildren children

code.gurobipy: model.addConstr(BusCapacity * NumBuses + CarCapacity * NumCars >= MinChildren, name="MinChildrenConstr")

constraints.description: There must be more buses than personal cars
There must be at least MinCars personal cars

objective.description: Minimize the total number of buses and personal cars scheduled
